SELECT
    time AS "Time",
    sensor_id AS "Sensor",
    temperature AS "Temperature (°C)",
    ph AS "pH",
    turbidity AS "Turbidity (NTU)",
    chlorine AS "Chlorine (mg/L)",
    tds AS "TDS (ppm)",
    conductivity AS "Conductivity (µS/cm)",
    dissolved_oxygen AS "DO (mg/L)",
    oxidation_reduction_potential AS "ORP (mV)"
FROM water_sensors
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC;

SELECT
    time AS "time",
    conductivity AS "Conductivity (µS/cm)"
FROM water_sensors
WHERE
    sensor_id = 'node1'
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC;
